2. **`core/hangar/progress.py`**: create it with exactly this content.
```python
"""Generate PROGRESS.md from the plan, reviews/ and ledger/items.yaml. Pure and deterministic."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

from .ledger import KINDS, STATUSES, Ledger

UNIT_RE = re.compile(r"^### Unit (U\d+\.\d+): (.*)$")
UNIT_ID_RE = re.compile(r"U\d+\.\d+")
WAVE_RE = re.compile(r"^\|\s*(W\d+\b[^|]*)\|[^|]*\|([^|]*)\|")
CHECK_RE = re.compile(r"^- \[( |x)\]")
REVIEW_HEAD_RE = re.compile(r"^## (U\d+\.\d+)\b")
VERDICT_RE = re.compile(r"^###\s+Verdict\b[^:\n]*:\s*(ACCEPT|REJECT)\b")


def active_plan(root: Path) -> Path:
    """Newest plans/*.md by file name (same rule as harness/hooks/agent_gate.py)."""
    plans = sorted((Path(root) / "plans").glob("*.md"), key=lambda p: p.name)
    if not plans:
        raise FileNotFoundError("no plans/*.md")
    return plans[-1]


def parse_units(lines: list[str]) -> dict[str, dict]:
    """Units under '## 7.' -> {id: {title, done, total}}. Checkboxes inside code fences are ignored."""
    units: dict[str, dict] = {}
    in_units = False
    fenced = False
    current = None
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith("## "):
            in_units = line.startswith("## 7.")
            current = None
            fenced = False
            continue
        if not in_units:
            continue
        m = UNIT_RE.match(line)
        if m:
            current = m.group(1)
            units[current] = {"title": m.group(2).strip(), "done": 0, "total": 0}
            fenced = False
            continue
        if line.lstrip().startswith("```"):
            fenced = not fenced
            continue
        if current and not fenced:
            c = CHECK_RE.match(line)
            if c:
                units[current]["total"] += 1
                if c.group(1) == "x":
                    units[current]["done"] += 1
    return units


def parse_waves(lines: list[str]) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
    """Rows of the '## 6.' table whose first cell starts with W<digit> -> [(wave name, [unit ids])]."""
    waves = []
    in_sched = False
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith("## "):
            in_sched = line.startswith("## 6.")
            continue
        if line.startswith("### "):
            in_sched = False
        if in_sched:
            m = WAVE_RE.match(line)
            if m:
                waves.append((m.group(1).strip(), UNIT_ID_RE.findall(m.group(2))))
    return waves


def latest_verdicts(root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Unit id -> ACCEPT/REJECT. Rule: files in reviews/*.md sorted by name; inside a file, each '## U<n>.<n> ...'
    section; the LAST line in that section matching '### Verdict...: ACCEPT|REJECT' wins; later files override earlier."""
    verdicts: dict[str, str] = {}
    for path in sorted((Path(root) / "reviews").glob("*.md"), key=lambda p: p.name):
        unit = None
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            if line.startswith("## "):
                m = REVIEW_HEAD_RE.match(line)
                unit = m.group(1) if m else None
                continue
            v = VERDICT_RE.match(line)
            if v and unit:
                verdicts[unit] = v.group(1)
    return verdicts


def _status(done: int, total: int) -> str:
    if total and done == total:
        return "done"
    return "in progress" if done else "not started"


def _unit_row(uid: str, u: dict, verdicts: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return f"| {uid} | {u['title']} | {u['done']}/{u['total']} | {_status(u['done'], u['total'])} | {verdicts.get(uid, '-')} |"


def build_progress(root: Path, today: str | None = None) -> str:
    root = Path(root)
    plan = active_plan(root)
    lines = plan.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    units = parse_units(lines)
    verdicts = latest_verdicts(root)
    out = [
        "# Progress",
        "",
        f"> GENERATED by `plane progress --write` from `plans/{plan.name}`, `reviews/` and `ledger/items.yaml`. Do not edit by hand.",
    ]
    if today:
        out.append(f"> As of {today}.")
    placed: set[str] = set()
    out += ["", "## Units by wave"]
    header = ["", "| unit | title | done/total | status | review |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for name, ids in parse_waves(lines):
        out += ["", f"### {name}"] + header
        for uid in ids:
            if uid in units:
                out.append(_unit_row(uid, units[uid], verdicts))
                placed.add(uid)
    rest = sorted(set(units) - placed, key=lambda s: tuple(int(x) for x in s[1:].split(".")))
    if rest:
        out += ["", "### Unscheduled"] + header
        out += [_unit_row(uid, units[uid], verdicts) for uid in rest]
    ledger = Ledger(root / "ledger" / "items.yaml")
    out += ["", "## Ledger", "", "| kind | " + " | ".join(STATUSES) + " | total |", "|" + "---|" * (len(STATUSES) + 2)]
    for kind in KINDS:
        rows = [i for i in ledger.items if i.kind == kind]
        counts = [sum(1 for i in rows if i.status == s) for s in STATUSES]
        out.append(f"| {kind} | " + " | ".join(map(str, counts)) + f" | {len(rows)} |")
    if today:
        overdue = sorted(ledger.report_overdue(today))
        out += ["", f"## Overdue as of {today}", ""]
        out += [f"- {i} (due {ledger.get(i).due}): {ledger.get(i).text}" for i in overdue] or ["none"]
    else:
        out += ["", "## Overdue", "", "not computed (run `plane progress --today YYYY-MM-DD`)"]
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"
```

3. **`core/hangar/cli.py`**: add this block after the `ledger_report` function and before `def main():` (nothing else in the file changes; `click`, `Path` and `_repo_root` already exist there):
```python
@cli.command("progress")
@click.option("--write", "write", is_flag=True, help="Write PROGRESS.md at the repo root.")
@click.option("--check", "check", is_flag=True, help="Exit 1 if PROGRESS.md differs from the generated text.")
@click.option("--today", default=None, help="Add an 'as of' line and the overdue list (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: none, so output is deterministic.")
def progress_cmd(write, check, today):
    """Print, write or check PROGRESS.md (generated from the plan, reviews and ledger)."""
    from .progress import build_progress

    if write and check:
        click.echo("plane: use --write or --check, not both", err=True)
        sys.exit(2)
    root = _repo_root()
    text = build_progress(root, today=today)
    target = root / "PROGRESS.md"
    if write:
        target.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))
        click.echo("wrote PROGRESS.md")
    elif check:
        if not target.exists() or target.read_bytes() != text.encode("utf-8"):
            click.echo("PROGRESS.md is stale: run `plane progress --write` and commit it")
            sys.exit(1)
        click.echo("PROGRESS.md is up to date")
    else:
        click.echo(text, nl=False)
```
Then run `plane progress --write` (never write PROGRESS.md by hand) and commit the result.

4. **`PROGRESS.md`**: produced only by `plane progress --write` from the worktree root, after step 3, and again right before committing.

### Workflow consequence (state it in your final report, do not implement it)
Every edit of a `- [ ]` / `- [x]` line in the plan, a new `### Unit`, a new or changed `reviews/*.md` verdict, or a ledger change makes `PROGRESS.md` stale and turns CI red. Whoever does that edit runs `plane progress --write` in the same commit. The conductor decides where to put this rule (proposed: `.claude/agents/conductor.md` and the commit rules in `CLAUDE.md`). Also after W0.6a/b merge, the conductor runs `plane progress --write` once if `--check` reports stale.

## Exact tests
`tests/test_progress.py` (new):
```python
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from click.testing import CliRunner

from hangar.cli import cli
from hangar.ledger import Ledger
from hangar.progress import build_progress, latest_verdicts, parse_units

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

PLAN = """# P
## 6. Schedule

| Wave | Dates (PT) | Units |
|---|---|---|
| W0 First | Fri 11-20 | U0.1, U0.2 [hard] |
| W1 Second | Sat 11-21 | U1.1 |
| Freeze | Sun | - |

## 7. Units

### Unit U0.1: Alpha
- [x] **Step 1: a**
- [x] **Step 2: b**
### Unit U0.2: Beta (extra) [hard]
- [x] a
- [ ] b
@@
- [ ] inside a code fence is ignored
@@
### Unit U1.1: Gamma
- [ ] a
### Unit U9.9: Orphan
- [x] a
## 8. End
- [ ] not counted
""".replace("@@", "```")
REVIEW_A = """## U0.1 Alpha @ branch
### Verdict: REJECT (round 1). fix
### Round 2
### Verdict round 2: ACCEPT
## U0.2 Beta
### Verdict: REJECT (round 1). fix
## W9 not a unit
### Verdict: ACCEPT
"""
REVIEW_B = """## U0.2 Beta round 2
### Verdict: ACCEPT
"""


@pytest.fixture
def repo(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    (tmp_path / "pyproject.toml").write_text("[project]\nname='x'\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "plans").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "plans" / "2026-11-20-p.md").write_text(PLAN, encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "reviews").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "reviews" / "2026-11-20-a.md").write_text(REVIEW_A, encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "reviews" / "2026-11-21-b.md").write_text(REVIEW_B, encoding="utf-8")
    led = Ledger(tmp_path / "ledger" / "items.yaml")
    led.add("task", "late thing", source="x", due="2026-11-01")
    led.add("idea", "someday", source="x")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    return tmp_path


def run(*args):
    return CliRunner().invoke(cli, ["progress", *args])


def test_counts_per_unit_ignore_fences_and_other_sections(repo):
    u = parse_units(PLAN.splitlines())
    assert (u["U0.1"]["done"], u["U0.1"]["total"]) == (2, 2)
    assert (u["U0.2"]["done"], u["U0.2"]["total"]) == (1, 2)
    assert (u["U1.1"]["done"], u["U1.1"]["total"]) == (0, 1)


def test_waves_status_and_verdict_columns(repo):
    text = build_progress(repo)
    assert text.index("### W0 First") < text.index("### W1 Second") < text.index("### Unscheduled")
    assert "| U0.1 | Alpha | 2/2 | done | ACCEPT |" in text
    assert "| U0.2 | Beta (extra) [hard] | 1/2 | in progress | ACCEPT |" in text
    assert "| U1.1 | Gamma | 0/1 | not started | - |" in text
    assert "| U9.9 | Orphan | 1/1 | done | - |" in text


def test_verdict_rule_last_in_section_then_later_file_wins(repo):
    assert latest_verdicts(repo) == {"U0.1": "ACCEPT", "U0.2": "ACCEPT"}


def test_ledger_counts_and_overdue(repo):
    text = build_progress(repo)
    assert "| task | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |" in text
    assert "| idea | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |" in text
    assert "not computed" in text and "As of" not in text
    dated = build_progress(repo, today="2026-11-20")
    assert "As of 2026-11-20." in dated and "(due 2026-11-01): late thing" in dated


def test_output_is_deterministic(repo):
    assert build_progress(repo) == build_progress(repo)
    assert build_progress(repo, today="2026-11-20") == build_progress(repo, today="2026-11-20")


def test_check_exit_codes(repo):
    assert run("--check").exit_code == 1  # no PROGRESS.md yet
    assert run("--write").exit_code == 0
    assert run("--check").exit_code == 0
    p = repo / "plans" / "2026-11-20-p.md"
    p.write_text(PLAN.replace("- [ ] b", "- [x] b"), encoding="utf-8")
    r = run("--check")
    assert r.exit_code == 1 and "stale" in r.output and len(r.output.strip().splitlines()) == 1
    assert run("--write", "--check").exit_code == 2


def test_no_flag_prints_to_stdout_and_writes_nothing(repo):
    r = run()
    assert r.exit_code == 0 and r.output.startswith("# Progress")
    assert not (repo / "PROGRESS.md").exists()


def test_real_repo_write_then_check_passes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    shutil.copytree(REPO / "plans", tmp_path / "plans")
    shutil.copytree(REPO / "reviews", tmp_path / "reviews")
    shutil.copytree(REPO / "ledger", tmp_path / "ledger", ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("prompts.jsonl", "events.jsonl"))
    (tmp_path / "pyproject.toml").write_text("[project]\nname='x'\n", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run("--write").exit_code == 0
    assert run("--check").exit_code == 0


def test_committed_progress_md_is_fresh_and_marked_generated():
    committed = (REPO / "PROGRESS.md").read_bytes()
    assert committed == build_progress(REPO).encode("utf-8")
    assert b"GENERATED by `plane progress --write`" in committed


def test_roadmap_is_short_and_traceable():
    text = (REPO / "ROADMAP.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert len(text.splitlines()) <= 60
    for needle in ["2026-12-01", "W0", "W1", "W2", "W3", "W4", "D10", "plans/2026-11-20-standardization.md", "PROGRESS.md"]:
        assert needle in text, needle
```
